text:
5. 2. 5. 5

(Akuppasuttaṃ)

(Sāvatthinidānaṃ:)

45. Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirasseva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhati. Katamehi pañcahi:

Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu atthapaṭisamhidāpatto hoti, dhammapaṭisamhidāpatto hoti, niruttipaṭisamhidāpatto hoti, paṭibhānapaṭisamhidāpatto hoti, yathā vimuttaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhati. 

Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirasseva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhatiti.
